item.title: Police investigating after device thrown at anti-Islam protest in New York City
item.description: Authorities say a counterprotester demonstrating against a “Stop the Islamic Takeover of New York City” event Saturday lit and threw a device at the protesting crowd after someone from that group used pepper spray on the counterprotest

item.title: Body found in a Casey County pond amid search for missing 28-year-old man
item.description: According to the Casey County Coroner, a deceased male has been found dead in a pond off of Deany Vanoy Road eight miles west of Liberty.

item.title: Scott County firefighter encourages fire safety during statewide burn ban
item.description: While the state of Kentucky is under a burn ban until April 30, it's best to practice fire safety to prevent any small fires from igniting.
